purpose: Measure how InternVLA-N1 DualVLN behaves under Lite3-motivated camera geometries in the official InternNav evaluator on the two frozen skokloster-castle episodes, against the recorded baseline, to recommend keeping, raising, or re-pitching the Lite3 camera mount.

authorization.scope: Bounded pretrained simulation only: at most 20 supervised evaluator runs of 1,800 s each on rented4090. No training, no fine-tuning, no robot actuation, no changes to model or evaluator logic, no new episodes, no stopping of unrelated processes.
